Trial NCT05824559 start date was 2023-08-07, primary completion date was 2024-07-09, and completion date was 2024-07-23 with an enrollment of 23.
ME-344 has no FDA approval application on Drugs@FDA.
Bevacizumab has multiple FDA-approved applications on Drugs@FDA.
